card.title: The Favor Not Yet Named
card.instruction: Behave as though you hold decisive leverage, but delay naming it until another explanation has taken root.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you explain why I shouldn't join the committee, shall I keep this envelope closed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me your reasons first. They sound carefully prepared.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only admit people who contribute to the building.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then perhaps now is the moment for my receipt for its new roof.

mechanism: A signals an envelope as decisive leverage while withholding its content until B commits to an admission rationale.
confusable: Unlike generic secrecy, delayed disclosure must overturn the specific explanation B first establishes.
comparison: S222-a reveals a roof contribution after the membership criterion; S222-b reveals a prior piano move after a self-reliance principle.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
